page.layout: One page of verse. Running verse at top, then a right-aligned attribution line "AD. B. POM.", then a centred title "E Y X H." and a second poem below it. Catchword at the lower right. No margin text.

main_text.p: Vicunq;[?] tristibus fatigar, Fine bono mala fata claudis.
Non templa Olympi,non ego possidet Quæcunq; mundus,pro solido tuo Mutem fauore.hæc cuncta sperno, Tu modo si mihi promptus adsis.
In peius ergo cuncta ruant licet: Tabescat æstu cor trepidum mihi: In morte dira tu salutis Spes remanes mea,forsq; dulcis.
Nam iussa spernunt qui tua, duriter Punis:rebelles,ac alijs diis Qui fornicantur,sæuus ira, Perpetuis tenebris recondis.
Sincera uitæ me iuuat unica Ergo hæc uoluptas,ut celebrem,Deus, Te iugiter,tum magna mundo Facta canam tua semper ore.
main_text.head: E Y X H.
main_text.p: Nate Dei:cum Patre,sacro & Spiramine Numen Unum:qui motu cuncta quietus agis: Qui residens intra te,ambis uertigine cuncta, Illustrans uultu quæq; creata tuo:. Conspicuus,pariterq; inuisus:temporis author Absq; æuo:Modicus,fine modoq; carens:

page.notes: The printed title "E Y X H." is set in Roman capitals (it is the Greek word εὐχή, but printed here in Latin letters), so it is copied as printed. "Vicunq;" is the first word of the page: the abbreviation mark is read as "q;" with a doubt. The faint text at the right edge is show-through from the other side of the leaf and is left out. No running head, signature or other page furniture is printed.
